notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Felidar Guardian.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Felidar Guardian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Nykthos.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Felidar Guardian.
Repeat.
If your devotion to blue is at least five, this combo nets infinite mana.
